
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/23115325" title="发布于 2026-09-24 19:16">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Java标签跳转：一个鲜为人知但却很实用的小技巧</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在C系风格的代码中，标签是一个容易掌握但是却很难熟练使用的特性，容易主要体现在其规则简单，配合goto很容易就能实现一些比较复杂的逻辑。很难熟练使用主要是体现在对于复杂场景下，不好对流程把控，调试，也不好维护，是典型的面向过程的特性。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">前两天在看jdk源码的时候，无意中看到线程池中这个方法的源码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> addWorker(Runnable firstTask, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> core) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">        retry:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> c =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctl.get();;) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Check if queue empty only if necessary.</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (runStateAtLeast(c, SHUTDOWN)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>                 &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (runStateAtLeast(c, STOP)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>                     || firstTask != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>                     ||<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> workQueue.isEmpty()))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (;;) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (workerCountOf(c)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>                     &gt;= ((core ? corePoolSize : maximumPoolSize) &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> COUNT_MASK))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (compareAndIncrementWorkerCount(c))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> retry;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>                 c = ctl.get();  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Re-read ctl</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (runStateAtLeast(c, SHUTDOWN))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>                     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> retry;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> else CAS failed due to workerCount change; retry inner loop</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> .....</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我一开始以为标签是配合goto 用的，但是仔细一看没有goto 字段，是配合 break，continue来使用的。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">详细查了下这个特性，其实很简单。主要是在代码块来使用，总体来说存在两种使用场景</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong><span style="font-size: 18px">场景一：</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在普通代码块中，配合break关键字使用：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在代码块前边声明一个标签，当执行代码块时，如果发现需要提前结束代码块，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )直接break 标签即可。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">普通代码块既可以是 {} 直接包裹的方法，也可以是if/else 语句的代码块</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">依次来看这几个例子</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（1）普通代码块</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Label1 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        step1:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>             i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i == 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step1;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             i = 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         System.out.println("i is :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>i is :2</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（2）if代码块</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Label2 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>         i++;<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">i = 1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        step2:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i != 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>             i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i == 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step2;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>             i = 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         System.out.println("i is :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>i is :2</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">（3）else 代码块</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Label3 {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        i</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i == 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
            i </span>= 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step3:{
            i</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i == 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step3;
            }
            i </span>= 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        System.out.println(</span>"i is :" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>i is :3</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">以前看有人些写的代码，喜欢使用这种伪代码块(或者叫做业内常叫「<strong>伪块 / 一次性代码块</strong>) ，其实都一个意思</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">do sth</span>
        } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">然后通过break来随时控制，do sth内部的逻辑来提前结束，其实大可不必。只要用标签加普通代码块的格式即可简单实现易读易理解的代码了。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>场景二：</strong></span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">在标签关联的循环中，配合break/continue 来操作。我们知道如果在多层循环，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )内循环想直接退出外层循环，或者直接重新开始外层循环是很繁琐的。但是配合标签，就好处理的多了。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我们以do while加while来举例子：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Label4 {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main(String[] args) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> i = 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        step4:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i &lt;= 105<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    i</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                    System.out.println(</span>"current i is" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i);
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">continue</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step4;
                }
                i </span>= i + 100<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                System.out.println(</span>"current i is" +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> i);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (i &gt; 300<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> step4;
                }
                i</span>--<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出结果如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">current i is101
current i is102
current i is103
current i is104
current i is105
current i is106
current i is206
current i is305</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
